title: {{ .service }} · SLO fast burn
description: Burn rate above {{ .threshold }} over the last hour (SLO {{ .target }}%). Runbook: {{ .runbook }}

input.value:
fetch spans, from:-1h
| filter service.name == "{{ .service }}" and span.kind == "server"
| makeTimeseries { total = count(), bad = countIf(http.response.status_code >= 500) }, interval:5m
| fieldsAdd burn_rate = (bad[] / total[]) / (1 - {{ .target }} / 100)
| fields timeframe, interval, burn_rate
